copy.curiosityHook: As home life fractures, how will she carve out her own space among new classmates and the awkward rush of adolescent freedom?
copy.description: In Paris, a thirteen-year-old French girl faces the double challenge of settling into a new school and coping with her parents' looming divorce, balancing teen social life with sudden family upheaval.
copy.vibeSummary: Warm, funny, and emotional with an easy viewing rhythm that treats adolescent growing pains and family turmoil with gentle honesty.
copy.whyWatch: Claude Pinoteau balances comic charm with heartfelt domestic friction, capturing the bittersweet momentum of growing up amid major household change.
